flags.summary: A 62-year-old prospect disclosed a detached retina surgically repaired seven weeks earlier and was taken through a loaded kettlebell offer and a readiness commitment without a single follow-up question about restrictions, recovery or clinician clearance.
evidence: right now, I'm really trying to catch up because I just had eye surgery in March, March 23rd, I had a detached retina. So, for the last two and a half months, two months, I have not worked.

So John, this is where you're going to get two separate. The program's designed for your body specifically by Trevor, a kettlebell-based program and a mobility-based program. On the kettlebell side, it's just three to four times per week, 30 minutes per session.
So John, are you actually ready to take that step? Yep. I'm ready to do it.

flags.summary: A three-month tier at $4,000 was presented as a standard programme level; the sanctioned offer is $6,000/6mo and $9,000/12mo only. Third consecutive call by this rep with the same deviation.
evidence: We have two levels of the program, a three months and a six. My recommendation for you just in terms of how long it's been since you've actually been in your ideal body or ideal self is six months.
So for three months, the investment is $4,000 and for six, it's six.

flags.summary: The rep prescribed fasting protocols as part of the programme, describing fasting as a natural remedy for the body, to a 62-year-old prospect whose medical history had never been asked about and who had disclosed recent surgery.
evidence: We're providing you recommendations as to what food groups should be in your diet, what food groups should be removed, how should you supplement your body. When it comes to fasting protocols, we're huge on fasting, right? a great natural remedy for the body.

flags.summary: After the affordability objection the rep presented a separate $200/month product, Primal University, as the fallback — a price point outside the sanctioned coaching offer, consistent with the same move on the 2026-05-10 call.
evidence: So this is what we call Primal University. Yes, I do. It's just, yeah, Primal University is a system designed by Trevor
So the investment for it is just 200 bucks, okay? You can cancel it at any time. So some people come in for a month, they get what they need, and they leave, okay?

flags.summary: The prospect's personal phone number is embedded in his speaker label and therefore repeated on every line of the stored transcript, spreading identifiable contact data through the corpus.
